current.text: Rookie, taken 14th overall in the 2026 draft.
He is projected to come off the bench. The projected starters are White, Knueppel, Miller, Reid and Diabaté.
Charlotte's center plan is unclear. He competes with Moussa Diabaté and Ryan Kalkbrenner for center minutes, and Naz Reid also plays in the frontcourt.
He is expected to be next in the frontcourt rotation after Diabaté and Reid. He can play next to Diabaté in four-out lineups, and some people talk about starting him.
Charlotte will probably run a three-center rotation and also uses Grant Williams as a small-ball five. He likely will not get near 30 minutes.
Charlotte did not let him shoot threes in Summer League. The team also kept Kalkbrenner from shooting threes last season.
He is a stash in deep (16-team) leagues. Draft him in all leagues if he is named a starter.
Charlotte plays 4-3-4 games in the fantasy playoff weeks for a March 28 end and has only 13 back-to-backs, the league minimum.

durable.text: He was the best rebounder in college basketball, and his rebounding carried over to Summer League.
Monster, hyper-competitive rebounder who can also block shots.
Pretty good scorer with good usage and good FG% and FT%. He has some three-point range but is not a real shooter yet.

note: Both Yahoo and ESPN value him at 0 USD (Yahoo rank 677, ESPN rank 250). The projections give him about 18 minutes, 4.7 rebounds and 0.9 blocks, so he should not be one of the 144 players drafted in our 12-team league unless Charlotte names him a starter before the draft. Watch the preseason and the first weeks of the season. If he takes the center job from Diabaté or Kalkbrenner, his rebounds, blocks and low turnovers make him a quick FAB add.
